questions.enonce_markdown: Name the THREE main types of neurones and state the functions of each. *(6 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
| Type of neurone | Function |
|---|---|
| **Sensory (afferent) neurone** | Carries **nerve impulses from the sense organs (receptors) to the central nervous system** (brain or spinal cord). |
| **Relay (intermediate, connector or association) neurone** | Found in the central nervous system; **connects sensory neurones to motor neurones** and passes impulses between them. |
| **Motor (efferent) neurone** | Carries **nerve impulses from the central nervous system to the effectors** (muscles or glands), which then respond. |

questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a large and neatly labelled diagram of the mammalian brain. *(7 marks)*

State the functions of the following parts of the brain:

(i) Cerebrum

(ii) Medulla Oblongata

(iii) Cerebellum. *(3, 2, 2 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Cerebrum**:
1. Centre of **thinking, intelligence, memory, learning and reasoning**.
2. Controls **voluntary actions** (voluntary movements) and **receives and interprets sensations** (sight, hearing, touch, taste, smell) from the sense organs.

(ii) **Medulla oblongata**: controls **involuntary actions**, for example the **breathing rate and heartbeat rate**, and also swallowing, coughing, vomiting and the diameter of blood vessels.

(iii) **Cerebellum**: **coordinates muscular movement** and **maintains balance (equilibrium) and posture** of the body.
